The '''mind healer's grove''', also known as the '''Spirit Healers' grove''', was a cave on the [[Russet Slopes]] of the [[Old Paths]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The cave was home to ancient ruins, and was used by the spirit healers and [[dream-walkers]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. The [[Children of the Emperor|Child]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] [[Suri]] made camp in the cave while being driven mad by the injured Emperor's mental raging.
